description: The engine ids a session may run on (provenance.json $defs/engine), in order: the Desk's two, then deepagents (ADR-0003), then eino, the Go adapter (ADR-0004). The first three are the TypeScript registry's ids (ASSISTANT_ENGINES); eino is the Go module's (go/adapter/wire, EngineID) and is not loaded by the TypeScript registry.
